mapper.update: update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select:
-- 2. 안쪽에서 계산된 출석률(attendanceRate)과 미납액(unpaidAmount)을 바탕으로 위험도(riskLevel)를 판별합니다. select main.*, case -- [위험 기준] 출석률 70% 미만이거나, 미납액이 10만원 이상일 때 when main.attendanceRate < 70 and main.unpaidAmount >= 100000 then '위험' -- [주의 기준] 출석률 85% 미만이거나, 미납액이 1원이라도 있을 때 when main.attendanceRate < 85 and main.unpaidAmount > 0 then '주의' -- 그 외에는 모두 안전! else '안전' end as riskLevel from ( -- 1. 학생 기본 정보, 누적 미납액, 출석률을 먼저 싹 다 계산해서 main이라는 가상 테이블로 만듭니다. select s.student_no as studentNo, a.account_name as studentName, s.student_school as studentSchool, s.student_grade as studentGrade, s.student_academic_status as studentAcademicStatus,
-- 미납액 계산 로직 (기존 totalUnpaidAmount와 dummy를 합쳐서 unpaidAmount로 통일) nvl(( select sum(p.payment_amount - nvl( (select sum(h.payment_history_amount) from payment_history h where h.payment_no = p.payment_no) , 0)) from payment p where p.student_no = s.student_no and p.payment_status != '완납' ), 0) as unpaidAmount,
-- 출석률 계산 로직 (아까 만든 서브쿼리 적용) nvl(( select case when count(cs.session_no) = 0 then 0 else round((count(att.attendance_no) / count(cs.session_no)) * 100) end from student_course sc inner join schedule sch on sc.course_no = sch.course_no inner join class_session cs on sch.schedule_no = cs.schedule_no left join attendance att on cs.session_no = att.class_session_no and att.student_no = sc.student_no and att.attendance_state = '출석' where sc.student_no = s.student_no and sc.student_course_status in ('수강중', '수강완료') ), 0) as attendanceRate
from student s inner join account a on s.account_no = a.account_no
and exists ( select 1 from payment p where p.student_no = s.student_no and p.payment_status != '완납' )
and s.student_academic_status = '대기'
and s.student_academic_status in ('휴원', '퇴원')
and ( a.account_name like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' or s.student_school like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
) main order by main.studentNo desc
mapper.update: update account set account_phone = #{studentPhone}, account_name = #{studentName}, account_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}

update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_gender = #{studentGender}, student_etc = #{studentEtc}, student_utime = systimestamp where student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cs.session_no, cs.schedule_no, cs.classroom_no, cs.session_start, cs.session_end, cs.session_status FROM class_session cs JOIN schedule s ON cs.schedule_no = s.schedule_no JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no JOIN registration r ON c.course_no = r.course_no WHERE r.student_no = #{studentNo} AND r.registration_status = '수강중' AND cs.session_status = '진행중' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN (cs.session_start - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE) AND cs.session_end ORDER BY cs.session_start ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

select case -- 분모(총 수업 수)가 0이면 출석률도 0 반환 (에러 방지) when total_sessions = 0 then 0 -- (분자 / 분모) * 100 후 반올림(ROUND) 처리 else round((attended_sessions / total_sessions) * 100) end as attendance_rate from ( select -- [분모] 이 학생이 수강 중인 강의들의 총 열린 수업(세션) 갯수 (select count(CS.session_no) from student_course SC inner join schedule S on SC.course_no = S.course_no inner join class_session CS on S.schedule_no = CS.schedule_no where SC.student_no = #{studentNo} and SC.student_course_status in ('수강중', '수강완료') -- UI의 '4주' 기준을 맞추려면 아래 주석을 해제하세요! and CS.session_start >= trunc(sysdate) - 28 ) as total_sessions,
-- [분자] 이 학생이 실제로 '출석'한 갯수 (select count(A.attendance_no) from attendance A where A.student_no = #{studentNo} and A.attendance_state = '출석' -- 실제 출석을 의미하는 데이터 값으로 맞춰주세요 -- and A.attendance_at >= trunc(sysdate) - 28 ) as attended_sessions from dual )
